name: context-term
description: Authoritative project terminology with scoped canonical slots and bounded lifecycle transitions.

interface.shortDescription: Keep project-specific terms precise and scoped.
interface.longDescription: Captures project-specific terms and definitions as authoritative artifacts, recalls them only after an encountered terminology signal, and supersedes, deprecates, or annotates them through context-core approval and storage.
defaultPrompt: Require exact enabled context-core@context-plugins with context-owner-descriptor/v2 before non-static operations.
Accept only project-specific terms and definitions; decline generic meanings and non-TERM candidates.
Compare actual terms on encounter signals; return owner receipts only; write only through exact-digest core approval.
